moves.speaker: William Dembski
moves.claimSummary: If God is the source of all being and purpose, goodness cannot be an independent standard that God violates.
moves.reasonSummary: Any objective moral standard would have to derive from God rather than stand above the source of reality.

inferenceSummary.premise: Any objective moral standard would have to derive from God rather than stand above the source of reality.
inferenceSummary.inference: If any objective moral standard would have to derive from God rather than stand above the source of reality. then the stated claim materially affects the assigned burden.
inferenceSummary.conclusion: Once such a God exists, divine goodness follows from God's status as the ultimate standard, though lived evil remains an existential problem.

moves.claimSummary: Evolutionary and social conditioning can explain moral feelings but cannot make them objectively binding.
moves.reasonSummary: On atheism, opposed communities express different material dispositions, and evolutionary accounts that call morality an adaptive illusion remove its claimed objective reference.

inferenceSummary.premise: On atheism, opposed communities express different material dispositions, and evolutionary accounts that call morality an adaptive illusion remove its claimed objective reference.

inferenceSummary.conclusion: Atheistic moral indignation therefore borrows an objectivity that the worldview cannot ground.

Do not stitch separated excerpts or silently omit a premise to meet 2200 characters. If the unchanged proposition cannot be supported, report the exact conflict instead of rewriting it.

Anchors must prove the relevant component, not just be adjacent words. All support-map ranges must be inside your chosen evidence range.

Give source-specific endpoint explanations and describe exactly which original prefix/suffix was removed and why it is dispensable. If unchanged, explain the indispensable endpoint content. Do not include arbitrary 20-event buffer windows. Cite event numbers, not generic references to context.

Run the provided read-only checker on the full in-memory draft BEFORE final submission. It checks source exactness, anchors, bounds, keys and immutable identity. The controller separately reviews semantic minimality; a machine pass alone is insufficient.
